choices.why: The pale ash desk with tapered legs is pure Nordic style, and at 45 cm deep it sits lightly beside the window without blocking the light.
This light beech armchair with a woven cord seat has arms and a curved back for comfortable sitting, and it matches the ash desk in the same Scandinavian design language.
A tall light birch library holds plenty of books and fills the long white right-hand wall, keeping to the light woods the user asked for.
The cantilever armchair with a headrest is cosy for reading, its grey upholstery softens the space, and its dark frame echoes the black window frame.
The swing arm puts light directly over the book from beside the armchair, and the white shade and steel suit the minimal style.

answer.why: Light ash, beech and birch woods match the floor and white walls for a calm Nordic look, while the grey upholstery and the touches of black and steel tie in with the window frame for a bright, cohesive work and reading corner.
